newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Bullish dlr/mark pushes forint to end down vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bullish dlr/mark pushes forint to end down vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed weaker against a strong dollar on Tuesday's interbank forex market.
The forint finished at 155.95/156.00 to one dollar, compared to an opening of 155.56/66.

"It was all about the bullish dollar/mark today," said Pal Szucs of Hypo-Bank Hungaria. "Domestically, the forint stayed around 20 pips below the central bank bid for most of the trading session in the pattern of recent weeks."

The forint floats against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the Ecu and 30 percent of the dollar. In the absence of domestic factors, forint movements against the dollar are inversely proportional to trends in the dollar/Ecu and dollar/mark crosses.
Currency futures at the Budapest Commodity Exchange saw very high turnover of 6.38 billion dollars, mainly as a result of the strong dollar and Ecu, dealers said.
The Ecu accounted for almost half of all turnover and increased in value for most months, as did the dollar. The mark and yen fell in most contracts.
